source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

support.quote: When Riktor or Mourn catch you first, leaping in just feeds them; hold Skull Crusher until they have used their pull, then go.
support.issue: self-contradictory: if they caught you first, the pull is already used
support.rewrite: Against Riktor or Mourn, leaping in first just feeds their pull; hold Skull Crusher until they have used it, then go.

support.quote: If Riktor or Dekker stops your Stampede early, you are alone in their lane; wait for their stun to be used before charging.
support.issue: 'alone in their lane' is unclear for a support
support.rewrite: If Riktor or Dekker stops your Stampede early, you are stuck alone in front of them; wait for their stun to be used before charging.

support.quote: Finish with Curse while the Mark holds; once Lifecore and Noxia are done, stay beside your carry and save Swarm to peel.
support.issue: 'peel' is jargon and Swarm has no crowd control to protect anyone
support.rewrite: Finish with Curse while the Mark holds; once Lifecore and Noxia are done, stay beside your carry and save Swarm to escape danger.

support.quote: If Riktor or Dekker lands their stun or pull on you first, stop forcing Pounce and hold Boulder Throw to peel for your carry.
support.issue: 'peel' is jargon a new player won't get
support.rewrite: If Riktor or Dekker lands their stun or pull on you first, stop forcing Pounce and hold Boulder Throw to stun whoever jumps your carry.

offlane.quote: Against Grux or Crunch, never Reckoning a healthy bruiser alone; trade from range and reload with Hellfire Rounds before going back in.
offlane.issue: ability name used as a verb (broken grammar) and 'bruiser' jargon
offlane.rewrite: Against Grux or Crunch, never use Reckoning on a healthy fighter alone; trade from range and reload with Hellfire Rounds before going back in.

carry.quote: Open with Bloodbound for the attack speed, then grab the target with Arterial Grip and basic attack while Rupture lands. Once Orion and Tainted Scepter are done near minute 15, hold the grip through fights and use Exsanguinate on heroes to heal back.
carry.issue: Arterial Grip lasts only 3s, it cannot be held through whole fights
carry.rewrite: Open with Bloodbound for the attack speed, then grab the target with Arterial Grip and basic attack while Rupture lands. Once Orion and Tainted Scepter are done near minute 15, keep the grip unbroken and use Exsanguinate on heroes to heal back.

carry.quote: Against Sparrow or Murdock, any stun on you breaks Arterial Grip, so wait until their escape is used before you bind them.
carry.issue: reason (a stun) does not match the advice (wait for their escape); range also breaks the bind
carry.rewrite: Against Sparrow or Murdock, getting hit by their control or letting them run out of range breaks Arterial Grip, so wait until their escape is used before you bind them.
